The transformation centers on moving beyond traditional classroom lectures to small-group instruction tailored to each student's skill level. Teachers are spending more time individualizing instruction for individual kids, pulling small groups, and having smaller groups of students around the kidney table with them, Maine said.

lead_independence.headline: Man rescues woman trapped on railroad tracks in Hobe Sound as freight train approached
lead_independence.lead: Baur was leaving work Friday and heading home to Port Saint Lucie when he stopped at the crossing. He looked down at his phone, glimpsed up, and saw the car stuck behind the railroad crossing. Spoelstra was still inside that car, stuck on the train tracks. She had put her car in reverse, but the gate got stuck on top of her car on the antenna, and when she tried to reverse, it would not let her. She sat there and saw the train approaching.

lead_independence.headline: Murray Middle School rebuilding continues after tornado destroyed two buildings
lead_independence.lead: The multi-phase rebuilding project will deliver new facilities including band and chorus rooms, agricultural education spaces, a media center, administrative building, and additional classroom space.
